comment: The Credits pack move: each [Git Crafter path, Compute Crafter path] from source_commit. A path in edited has changed since: it takes engine names from lib (collectors/lib/engine.mjs), owns its paths, drops a plan-tier source (ideals/credits.json), or reads a committed catalog (targets/credits.json: credits.registry_age_days and params.catalog_file); collectors/credits/redact.test.mjs keeps only the Credits case. Every other file matches byte for byte. maps/spend.json is the spend entry of Git Crafter maps.json at source_commit, with absolute rule links, no plan-tier source, and a first step, fresh, scored by credits.registry_age_days. tests/engine-tests.sh checks the files, then runs the pack tests beside the engine at the ci.yml pin.
